You don't have to set anything up: the app brings its own key and TMDb works from the very first start — the movie's card, the episode mapping of a series and the ES→EN title translation for the CMv4.0 match.
Add yours only if you want to: if the app's key were to stop working (hit Test with the field empty to check), or if you'd rather your queries went to your own account. It's free and instant at themoviedb.org/settings/api → the “API Key (v3 auth)” field, the short one.
ui.un_rip_son_20_40_min_y_el_aviso: A rip takes 20-40 min and a CMv4.0 phase can take more than an hour. Desktop notifications need HTTPS, so on the NAS (which runs over HTTP) they aren't available.
